sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "song"."Singer_ID" AS e, SUM("song"."Sales") AS m1 FROM "song" GROUP BY "song"."Singer_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
why: total of units sold per singer (by Singer_ID) (additive)
gap to the all average of total of units sold (all level)
